battle.name: 裴行儉破西突厥之戰
battle.brief: 儀鳳四年（679）冬，裴行儉護薩珊王朝王子西行歸國，行至碎葉河畔，聞西突厥都支與吐蕃密謀截擊，遂分兵兼程、夜襲素葉城，生擒都支與同謀的吐蕃使者。卡面羅馬短劍為前1世紀羅馬步兵的標準近戰兵器，與本役相隔約八百年，並未出現在戰場上；同期唐軍用環首刀與唐刀，西突厥用馬刀與長矛。

kit.name: 羅馬短劍
kit.history: 刺劍不是用來揮砍的。短兵相接靠的是盾的邊緣和刺突的節奏。

countries: 裴行儉破西突厥之戰是唐儀鳳四年（679）冬天發生在碎葉河畔的一場遭遇戰，交戰一方是唐王朝護送使團及其護軍，另一方是西突厥王族阿史那都支的部眾；吐蕃派出的使者與都支同謀，因而一併捲入衝突。戰場在碎葉（素葉）城，即今中亞楚河谷地、吉爾吉斯斯坦托克馬克一帶，唐時是西突厥控制下的西域西部重鎮，也是唐安西都護府向西的實際邊界。唐方屬於朝廷的邊防與外交雙重體系：護送薩珊王朝末裔王子歸國復位是一次由鴻臚寺與中書省議定、由邊鎮將領執行的任務，隨行的護軍由裴行儉節制，配備步騎與帳幕，沿途由安西都護府與西域諸城提供糧秣與嚮導；兵員編制是行軍總管之下分為前隊、奇兵與後援，馬匹按甲士各帶數匹的舊例徵發。西突厥方面，當時汗廷分裂，都支是阿史那氏的一支，靠自己的封地與部眾維持一支可以獨立的軍隊，裝備以馬刀、長矛與角弓為主，善於以騎兵速度打游擊，而非正面列陣；吐蕃一方派出的是使者與隨行人馬，數量有限，但代表的是吐蕃在西域的介入意圖。交戰之後西域諸國，如吐火羅一類的小國，紛紛請降，這說明她們一直在觀望強勢一方的倒向。
countriesEn: The defeat of the Western Turks by Pei Xingjian was an engagement fought in the winter of the fourth year of Yifeng (679) beside the Suyab river. One side was the Tang mission with its escort; the other was the host of Ashina Du Zhi, a branch of the Western Turkic royal house. A Tibetan envoy was in conspiracy with Du Zhi and was drawn into the clash. The field of battle was Suyab, the town on the Chu river in what is now Kyrgyzstan, near Tokmok, then a western stronghold under Western Turkic control and the effective outer limit of the Tang Protectorate of the West. On the Tang side this belonged to the dual system of frontier defence and diplomacy at court: escorting the last descendant of the Sasanian house back to his throne was a task settled by the Court of State Hospitality and the Secretariat and carried out by a frontier general, and the escort that travelled with Pei Xingjian was composed of foot and horse with its tents, drawing grain and guides from the Protectorate of the West and the cities of the Western Regions along the road. Under the marching commander the force was divided into vanguard, striking troops and rearguard, and horses were requisitioned on the old rule of several beasts per armoured man. On the Western Turkic side the khaganate was divided, and Du Zhi belonged to a branch of the Ashina house that maintained an army of its own on the strength of its appanages and its people. Their arms were the sabre, the lance and the composite bow, and they were at their best striking in mounted harassment rather than standing in a line. Tibet had sent an envoy with a small following, few in number but carrying the intention of Tibetan involvement in the Western Regions. After the engagement small states of the Western Regions, among them the kingdom of Tukhara, sent requests for submission, which shows that they had been watching to see which of the strong powers was on the way up.
people: 本役最核心的人物是裴行儉，字守約，河東絳州聞喜人，早年在隋朝為吏，隋亡之後率部眾西奔，歸唐之後歷任要職，儀鳳年間奉命護送薩珊王朝末裔王子西行，是唐廷在西域經營上最能打的一批將領之一；據《舊唐書·裴行儉傳》，他其後拜安西都護，把整個安西的羈縻州縣重新整頓了一遍。與他同行的薩珊王子在史籍中名稱的譯寫不統一，本文不強指其原名，只能確定他是薩珊王朝末年被其兄篡位的王族後裔，隨行目的在於回國復位。被擒的西突厥主將阿史那都支是汗族的一支，679年時自領本部人馬，並非汗國的統一代表；他與唐廷此前已數度交手，部眾之中也曾有以詐降試探唐軍的記錄，顯示彼此並不陌生。他的實力不等於汗國整體的實力，這也是這場戰役容易被看輕的原因。吐蕃使者與都支同謀，名字在史書中不傳，只知其隨都支一同被擒。另一個不能忽略的「人物」是西域諸城：吐火羅一類的小國沒有直接出兵，但牠們的請降與否，決定了西突厥在費爾干納與錸爾河一帶的號召力往哪一邊傾斜。
peopleEn: The central figure is Pei Xingjian, courtesy name Shouyue, a native of Wenxi in Jiangzhou, Hedong. He began as a clerk under the Sui, moved west with his own followers when the Sui fell, and after submitting to the Tang held a series of important commands. In the Yifeng years he was ordered to escort the last descendant of the Sasanian house westwards, and he was among the most capable of the Tang commanders in the Western Regions; according to the biography in the Old Book of Tang he was later appointed Protector General of the West and reorganised the dependent prefectures and counties of Anxi from end to end. The Sasanian prince who travelled with him is written with inconsistent transliterations in the histories, so no original name is forced here; what can be established is that he was a descendant of the Sasanian royal house, displaced by a brother, and the purpose of the journey was to restore him to his throne. The captive Western Turkic commander, Ashina Du Zhi, was a branch of the khagan's house who in 679 still commanded his own people, and the earlier business of a wife who pretended to surrender and was executed in his presence shows that he and the Tang had already met. His strength was not the strength of the khanate as a whole, which is one reason the engagement could be underrated. The Tibetan envoy who was in conspiracy with him is not named in the histories; all that is known is that he was taken along with Du Zhi. One more actor cannot be left out: the cities of the Western Regions. States such as Tukhara put no soldiers into the field, but whether they sent in requests for submission decided where the authority of the Western Turks over Ferghana and the Syr Darya would lean.
kits: 卡面兵器是羅馬短劍（Gladius），約公元前1世紀已是羅馬步兵的標準配備，雙刃、短身、握柄有突鍔，配圓形小盾，刺擊靠的是握柄節奏與盾緣，而不是揮砍力道；它是「以刺代砍」這套近戰原則的源頭。史載有限的是，這件兵器沒有出現在679年的碎葉河畔，它與本役相隔約八百年，作為卡面只標示一種近戰辦法的出處。真正隨裴行儉西行的唐軍裝備，是一套為長途遠征設計的組合：遠射用角弓與弩，張力適中，適合騎射與行軍中的短射；近戰用環首刀與唐刀這類直刃、單邊、有格的刀，直刃好斬，也便於在馬上或帳旁抽用；長兵器是長槊，握在槊手前端的槊刃配長桿，衝鋒時用，防守時用來支起盾陣；投擲武器有擲標刀與標槊；防護有皮甲、札甲與護心鏡一類的部件，頭部用兜鍪與皮盔；宿營器材是帳幕、馬鍋與備用馬，一甲士往往自帶數匹馬，馬既是座騎，也是口糧與行李的搬運工具。糧秣不靠隨軍攜帶全部，沿途由西域城邑供給，這套補給辦法是唐在西域能維持遠征的前提。西突厥部眾的裝備以馬刀、長矛、角弓為主，鎧甲輕便，騎兵是主力；吐蕃使者的隨行人馬則按使團規格攜帶帳幕與禮物。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Roman gladius, standard kit for a Roman infantryman by about the first century BC: a double-edged blade, short, with a pommel and a distinct grip stop, and a small round shield. It was thrust rather than swung, the rhythm of the wrist and the rim of the shield doing the work, and it is the point of origin of the principle of stabbing instead of cutting in close combat. What must be said plainly is that this weapon did not appear on the Suyab river in 679; it stands about eight centuries away from the campaign and on the card it marks only the origin of one way of fighting at close quarters. The kit Pei Xingjian actually took west was a set designed for long-range expedition: at range, composite bows and crossbows of moderate power, suited both to shooting from horseback and to short shots on the march; at close quarters, ring-pommel knives and Tang-style sabres, straight-edged, single-edged and guarded, which cut well and could be drawn at the saddle or beside the tent; the long weapon was the lance, a long shaft with a bladed head carried by a hand-sapper at the front, used in the charge and to prop up a shield wall when defending; for throwing there were thrown sabres and javelins; for protection, leather and lamellar armour with breast and back plates, the head covered by iron helmets and leather caps; and for the camp, tents, cooking gear and remounts, each armoured man customarily taking several horses with him, the horse serving at once as mount, as baggage animal and as a source of meat. Grain was not all carried with the army but drawn from the cities of the Western Regions along the road, and that arrangement was the precondition for any Tang expedition this far west. The arms of the Western Turks were the sabre, the lance and the composite bow, with light armour and cavalry as the striking arm; the Tibetan envoy travelled with the fittings of a mission, tents and gifts.
tactics: 這場戰役的戰術核心是一個「快」字與一個「分」字。裴行儉護著使團西行，行至碎葉河一帶，得到西突厥都支正與吐蕃使者密謀、準備截擊使團並圖謀向吐火羅方向擴張的消息。他沒有急著正面推進，而是把隊伍分成兩路：一路是他自己率領的主力，繼續沿驛道緩行，讓敵人以為護軍仍在途中；另一路是分遣出去的輕裝隊伍，晝夜兼程，趨前偵察並乘夜接近素葉城，等到約定時機，突然發起攻擊。夜間進攻的好處在於視線與混亂：守城的突厥騎兵在夜裡無法展開衝鋒的寬度與速度，馬上反應也慢，而襲擊者不需要穿越開闊地帶，只要抵近城牆與門即可。奪門之後，裴行儉的部署是封鎖城周通道、切斷城內外聯絡，同時搜捕都支，切斷其部眾的指揮中樞；都支被擒後，戰局即告結束，餘眾失去統帥而潰散。事後的戰術延伸是政治性的：裴行儉沒有把俘虜與部眾一散了之，而是以唐的名義重排當地的羈縻關係，把西部諸部與城邑重新掛上安西都護府的名號，這是唐代在西域最典型的一套「以羈縻代征服」的收編辦法。
tacticsEn: The tactics of this engagement turn on two words, speed and division. While escorting the mission west, Pei Xingjian learned near the Suyab river that Ashina Du Zhi and the Tibetan envoy were in conspiracy and preparing to intercept the mission while extending towards Tukhara. He did not strike straight ahead. He split his force: he himself led the main body along the courier road at a measured pace, so that the enemy would believe the escort was still far away, while a light detachment was sent forward by night and day to reconnoitre and close on the town of Suyab, arriving at the appointed moment to attack without warning. The advantage of a night assault is sight and confusion: Turkic cavalry cannot open out to the width and speed of a charge in the dark, and a horse reacts slowly, while the attackers need no open ground, only the walls and the gate. Once the gate was taken, Pei Xingjian's arrangements were to seal the approaches, cut the town off from the countryside, and hunt down Du Zhi so as to break the nerve of his command. With Du Zhi in hand the action was over and the rest dissolved for want of a commander. The tactical sequel was political: Pei Xingjian did not simply scatter the prisoners and the people, but re-established the dependent relationships of the region under Tang authority, hanging the western clans and cities once more under the name of the Protectorate of the West. This was the classic Tang method in the Western Regions: substitution of the dependent system for outright conquest.
data: 可核的數字有限，應當先分清哪些是史文、哪些是推算。時間是唐高宗儀鳳四年，即679年冬，事起於護使西行途中，事畢於同年之內。《資治通鑑》記長安至素葉的行程約一萬餘里，唐一大里約合今五百五十米，折合五千五百公里以上；今西安至楚河谷的直線距離約四千公里，實際走的是經河西走廊、塔里木北緣、帕米爾與費爾干納的迂迴驛道，因此這個萬餘里的數字在量級上是合理的。戰場素葉城在楚河（碎葉水）河谷，約在北緯四十二點八度、東經七十五點三度，即今吉爾吉斯斯坦托克馬克一帶。護軍的實際兵員數，正史沒有留下可信記載；可以確定的只是它是一支以騎兵為骨幹、規模不大的精銳，而不是大軍。戰果方面，可以確定的兩項是：阿史那都支被生擒，同謀的吐蕃使者一併被擒；其餘如斬獲數、俘虜數與奪獲牲畜數，諸本記載互有出入，數字彼此矛盾，應當存疑，不宜引用。戰後西域諸國紛紛請降，這一點有《舊唐書》《新唐書》與《資治通鑑》三處可以互證，是本役影響面最確定的一項。
dataEn: Verifiable numbers are few, and it is worth separating what the texts actually say from what is inferred. The time is the fourth year of Yifeng, 679, in the winter, the action beginning while the mission was still on the road and ending within the same year. The Comprehensive Mirror gives the journey from Chang'an to Suyab as something over ten thousand li; a Tang great li is about 550 metres today, so that is more than 5,500 kilometres, while the straight line from modern Xi'an to the Chu valley is roughly 4,000 kilometres. The route actually followed was the circuitous one through the Hexi corridor, the northern rim of the Tarim, the Pamirs and Ferghana, so a figure of ten thousand li and more is reasonable in order of magnitude. The town of Suyab stood in the valley of the Chu, the Suyab river, at about 42.8 degrees north and 75.3 degrees east, in what is now the Tokmok area of Kyrgyzstan. The actual number of men in the escort is not credibly recorded; what can be said is that it was a small force with mounted troops at its core, not an army. Two results are certain: Ashina Du Zhi was taken alive, and the Tibetan envoy in conspiracy with him was taken with him. Figures for kills, captives and livestock seized differ between the texts and contradict one another, so they should be treated with suspicion and not quoted. The widest and best attested consequence is the flood of requests for submission from the states of the Western Regions, which the Old Book of Tang, the New Book of Tang and the Comprehensive Mirror all support.
cause: 這場戰役的起因有三層。最直接的一層是使團本身：薩珊王朝末裔王子被其兄篡位，唐廷決定護送他西行歸國復位，表面上是一次外交護送，實際上是一次在西域展示唐廷影響力的行動，同時也是打通波斯方向的商道與使節通道的舉動。第二層是西突厥自身的分裂：儀鳳年間西突厥汗廷分成數塊，各部首領各有部眾與城邑，都支只是其中一支；當他企圖截擊唐使、擴張到吐火羅方向時，他並沒有得到汗國整體的支持，這使他成為可以各個擊破的目標，也使他的計劃缺少外來的可靠援手。第三層是吐蕃的介入：吐蕃在西域與唐廷爭奪中介勢力，向西突厥的某一部提供支持與人馬，符合吐蕃的戰略利益，但正因為只是「一部分」，吐蕃的投入有限，一旦失敗便無法捲入報復。至於更遠的背景，則是唐在青海與涼州一線同吐蕃僵持不下，需要在西域打通一條能繞開正面消耗的通道，讓波斯方向的往來與西域的羈縻體系重新運轉。
causeEn: Three layers lie behind the engagement. The most immediate is the mission itself. A descendant of the Sasanian house had been displaced by his brother, and the Tang court decided to escort him west to restore him to his throne. On the face of it this was a diplomatic escort; in practice it was a demonstration of Tang influence in the Western Regions and an attempt to keep open both the trade road and the line of envoys running towards Persia. The second layer is the fragmentation of the Western Turks. Through the Yifeng years the Western Turkic khaganate was split into several blocks, each chief holding his own people and his own towns, and Du Zhi was only one of them. When he tried to intercept the Tang mission and push towards Tukhara, he had no backing from the khanate as a whole, which made him a target that could be taken alone and left his scheme without dependable outside help. The third layer is Tibetan involvement. Tibet competed with the Tang for the intermediary position in the Western Regions, and supporting one Western Turkic faction with men and supplies served Tibetan strategic interests; precisely because that support was only partial, Tibet's commitment was small, and once it failed there was no capacity for revenge. Behind all of this lay the broader background: the Tang were locked in a stalemate with Tibet along the Qinghai and Liangzhou lines and needed a corridor in the west that did not consume them head-on, so that traffic with Persia and the dependent system of the Western Regions could run again.
impact: 碎葉一戰的影響，超出戰場本身。第一，它把西突厥內部的權力天平推向了有利於唐的一邊：都支被擒，汗族的一支失去首領，其部眾或潰散、或轉投別人，唐廷不必出兵去打，只要承認與羈縻就能實際控制這些人。第二，它在語言與秩序上重整了西域：裴行儉其後拜安西都護，把安西都護府轄下州縣、官爵與使者往來重新整頓，使唐在西域的存在從「時有時無的出兵」變成「常設的羈縻網」；這張網在此後數十年裡支撐了絲路中段的秩序，直到安西四鎮在八世紀中葉被吐蕃切斷。第三，它打擊了吐蕃與西突厥結盟的企圖，讓吐蕃在西域少了一個可以借力的對手。第四，它與同年北方契丹寇朔州一事彼此映照：儀鳳年間的唐廷在東、西兩條線上同時作戰，策略上已由被動守禦轉向攻守並用。對裴行儉個人而言，這一仗是他西征經驗的頂點，其後他在安西與吐蕃交鋒、病卒於任上，成了一次成功的奇襲與一次未能阻止的崩解之間的先例。
impactEn: The consequences of the affair at Suyab reached well beyond the field. First, it tipped the internal balance of power in the Western Turks in the Tang's favour. With Du Zhi captured, one branch of the khagan's house lost its leader; his people either scattered or went over to others, and the Tang did not have to defeat them in battle, only to acknowledge and bind them in the dependent system in order to control them in practice. Second, it reordered the Western Regions in language and in institution. Pei Xingjian was afterwards appointed Protector General of the West and reorganised the prefectures, titles and envoys under the protectorate, so that the Tang presence in the Western Regions changed from an expedition that came and went into a standing web of dependent alliances; that web sustained the order of the middle of the Silk Road for the decades to come, until the Four Garrisons of Anxi were cut off by Tibet in the middle of the eighth century. Third, it spoiled the design of a Tibetan-Western Turkic alliance and left Tibet in the west with one fewer partner to rely on. Fourth, it throws light on the Khitan incursion at Shuozhou in the same year: during the Yifeng years the Tang were fighting on an eastern and a western front at once, and their strategy had already shifted from merely holding ground to holding and striking in the same campaign. For Pei Xingjian personally the victory was the summit of his experience in the west; he went on to fight the Tibetans in Anxi and died of illness in office, and his career became a precedent for what a successful surprise could achieve and what it could not prevent.
result: 結局是干脆而完整的：都支被生擒，同謀的吐蕃使者一併就擒，其部眾失去統帥而潰散，裴行儉一行護著波斯王子繼續西行，唐廷在西域第一次以一次小成本的奇襲換來了戰略上的大成果——沒有一座城被攻破，沒有一寸土地被征服，卻改變了整個區域的權力平衡。這正是唐代邊將所擅長的辦法：不追求佔地，只追求讓對方的組織結構失效。戰後西突厥諸部紛紛請降，裴行儉得以在沒有大軍的情況下完成對西域的重新編排，也因此得以拜安西都護。需要保留的懷疑有兩點：其一，波斯王子此行是否真正復位，正史沒有明文記載，而薩珊故地已為阿拉伯所據，此後西域與波斯的交通在相當一段時間內近乎斷絕，諸說並存，不宜斷言；其二，本次勝利並沒有解決西突厥內部的分裂，兩年後吐蕃仍舊進窺安西，唐廷在西北的處境並未因此根本好轉。能夠確定的結果只有三項：都支被擒，吐蕃使者被擒，西域諸國請降並被重新編入唐的羈縻秩序。
resultEn: The outcome was clean and complete. Du Zhi was taken alive, the Tibetan envoy in conspiracy was taken with him, and the clan that had gathered around the captive leader dissolved for want of one. Pei Xingjian went on west with the Sasanian prince, and the Tang court bought a large strategic return for a small outlay: no city was stormed and no ground was occupied, yet the balance of power across the whole region was altered. That is the method Tang frontier commanders were good at. They did not aim to take land; they aimed to break the enemy's organisation. After the action the clans of the Western Turks sent in requests for submission, and Pei Xingjian was able to rearrange the Western Regions without a field army, which is why he could be made Protector General of the West. Two cautions should be kept. First, whether the Persian prince ever actually recovered his throne is not stated in the official histories, and the Sasanian lands were already in Arab hands; traffic between the Western Regions and Persia was broken for a considerable time afterwards, the accounts differ, and no firm conclusion should be asserted. Second, the victory did not heal the division inside the Western Turks, and two years later the Tibetans were again pressing into Anxi, so the Tang position in the north-west was not fundamentally improved by it. Three results can be stated with certainty: Du Zhi was captured, the Tibetan envoy was captured, and the states of the Western Regions asked to submit and were reabsorbed into the Tang dependent order.
